parameters.content:
## TikTok Hashtag Momentum & Top Creator Tracker

**Actor:** [TikTok Hashtag Momentum & Top Creator Tracker](https://apify.com/dataspryva/tiktok-hashtag-momentum-and-top-creator-tracker)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/tiktok-hashtag-momentum-and-top-creator-tracker.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string)
- `countries` (array)
- `periods` (array)
- `includeOverallRanking` (boolean)
- `scanAllIndustries` (boolean)
- `industries` (array)
- `includeCreatorLeaders` (boolean)
- `minHashtagAppearances` (integer)
- `videoCountries` (array)
- `videoPeriods` (array)
- `videoSortBy` (string)
- `videoOrganicOnly` (boolean)

### Output fields
- `rankIndex` (Rank)
- `hashtagName` (Hashtag)
- `publishCnt` (Post Count)
- `vv` (Video Views)

description: TikTok trending hashtags: runs the TikTok Hashtag Momentum & Top Creator Tracker Apify Actor, returns rankIndex, hashtagName, publishCnt, vv and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
